authorization_basis: Creator instruction on 2026-10-21 explicitly re-authorizes background automatic Binance Square editorial publishing, restricted to the existing final quality, originality, evidence, WTE eligibility, visual-truth, duplicate, asset-cooldown, and editorial-only gates.
scope: publish only after every current-cycle quality and eligibility gate passes
continuous background research and outcome learning
must_not_claim: human review that did not occur
verified publication without current-run post ID
verified creator earnings from public metrics or unsupported claims
guardrails: Only EDITORIAL_ONLY content may publish; actionable entry/stop/target instructions and trade calls are forbidden.
Every publication requires fresh current-cycle eligibility, Signal-First permission, NIC 21 originality/visual-truth PASS, editorial lane PASS, and exact final-draft hash agreement.
The WTE eligibility gate must pass; missing or explicitly ineligible results fail closed.
Required visuals must have verified asset, timeframe, data and labels; never invent or mismatch chart symbols.
Duplicate and 72-hour asset cooldown checks remain active; no repeat unless explicit follow-up with genuinely new evidence.
Automatic publishing is rate-limited by the cadence controller; do not publish on every scheduler tick.
Live orders and trade-signal publication remain disabled.
Public views, comments, likes, follows and creator payout claims are not proof of earnings.
Optimize for genuine reader value and discussion; manufactured engagement, follow-for-follow, repetitive engagement bait, and copied wording are prohibited.
Every attempted publication must be audited; only current-run post ID and link count as confirmed publication.
